name: Same-data advanced selective-dependency model benchmark
objective: Test whether per-target Elastic Net, an expression-only DeepDEP adaptation, or multi-task reduced-rank regression improves over PCR-ridge under the same DepMap 24Q4 lineage-held-out benchmark.

scientific_boundary.primary_question: Does added estimator complexity improve cell-line selective-dependency ranking over PCR-ridge?
not_tested: Superiority over published metric values obtained from different releases or splits

data.models: The same 873 four-modality cancer models used by selective_dependency_benchmark_v1
data.outer_split: Reuse the exact 19 whole-lineage holdouts and patient-overlap purging recorded in selective_dependency_benchmark_v1/splits.csv.gz
data.target: Dependency minus the outer-training gene mean
data.target_universe: The 1,298 default DeepDEP DepOIs HGNC-canonicalized and intersected with DepMap 24Q4 targets; expected 1,204 before common-essential stratification
data.primary_gene_stratum: Release-wide non-common-essential targets in the shared DeepDEP-overlap universe; expected 911
data.expression_features: Official DeepDEP 6,016-feature order, canonical-symbol matched to DepMap 24Q4 expression; unavailable features filled with the official CCLE reference mean and audited
data.gene_fingerprints: Official Prep4DeepDEP 3,115-dimensional CGP fingerprints at pinned source commit f713c84b733a90d7644db789925a2fb4f9f41a68
data.unlabeled_pretraining: TCGA pan-cancer primary tumors excluding every KIRC sample and every frozen KIRC Train/Validation/Test identifier; no dependency or outcome label is used
data.locked_test_rule: No TCGA KIRC Locked Test expression, label, frequency or result may be read, used for tuning, or used for confirmation

methods.definition: Training-only PCA scores followed by per-target ridge
Separate coefficient vector per dependency target, optimized on GPU with the sklearn-scaled elastic-net objective and intercept
methods.selection: Report both shared-alpha lineage-equal NDCG selection and target-specific inner-MSE selection; the shared-alpha version is primary for ranking

methods.definition: Ridge fitted values projected onto a training-only target SVD subspace, sharing statistical strength across targets
methods.missing_rule: Training residual missing values are filled by the training-target mean after centering and the fraction is reported

methods.definition: Official 6016-500-200-50 ReLU expression encoder initialized by a tumor-expression autoencoder; official 3115-1000-100-50 CGP fingerprint encoder; concatenated 250-250-linear dependency head
methods.selection: One deterministic whole-lineage inner fold selects epoch count; refit on all outer-training models for that epoch count; average three frozen seeds
methods.naming_boundary: This is not a byte-identical rerun of the 2021 paper because the DepMap release, dependency target and split differ

evaluation.primary_endpoint: Lineage-equal NDCG@10 on the shared non-common-essential target universe
secondary_endpoints: Wall-clock time and peak GPU memory
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap by patient and sensitivity bootstrap by lineage; 20,000 GPU draws
evaluation.external_validation: Apply outer-lineage selected/refitted models to matching frozen Sanger lineages without Sanger label tuning when expression coverage permits
evaluation.decision_rule: A complex model is considered better than PCR-ridge only if its paired NDCG difference has a positive 95% interval internally and does not reverse direction in eligible Sanger models

engineering.device: CUDA required for fitting and bootstrap; no silent CPU fallback
engineering.precision: float32 neural optimization; float64 scoring, analytic decomposition and bootstrap where feasible
engineering.elastic_net_numerical_check: GPU proximal solver must agree with sklearn ElasticNet on a deterministic small synthetic problem before formal execution
engineering.output_policy: Refuse overwrite, write atomically, hash all inputs/scripts/outputs, retain only final research outputs and necessary audit tables
